items.title: 63519_Wild Bill Davison oral history interview
items.q: I've recorded with this guy Ted Easton; I've made several - several recordings with him

ctx.x: Just before you came back to work in Condon's this year--

Yeah - I went from Holland-- during the time I was in London this year, I went to Holland for two days and went back to England and I've recorded with this guy Ted Easton; I've made several - several recordings with him which only one has been released so far.
But, he is sitting on about four more.
